Agent: a new deal matches the buy box
Hello, the deal at {address} with an asking price of {asking_price} matches our buy box. Please send the seller details and a viewing date.
Hello, please send comparable sales for {address} from the last 12 months. We need them for the analysis.
Agent: our offer for the property
Hello, our offer for {address} is {offer_price}, open until {valid_until}. The asking price was {asking_price}.
Hello, we accept the counter-offer for {address} at {final_price}. Please send the contract to the closing coordinator.
Agent: we are passing on the property
Hello, we are passing on {address}. The numbers do not meet our target. Thank you for your time, please keep sending deals.
Agent: ask for the seller repair credit
Hello, the inspection of {address} found repairs of {repair_estimate}. Please ask the seller for a credit or a lower price.
Loan broker: please quote a loan
Hello, please quote a loan for {address}: price {offer_price}, rehab {rehab_budget}. We need the rate, the points and the cash to close.
Loan broker: compare the two quotes
Hello, we are comparing quotes for {address}. Please confirm the monthly payment of {payment} and the cash to close of {cash_to_close} in writing.
Loan broker: the appraisal came in low
Hello, the appraisal for {address} came in below the price. Please tell us what the lender will lend now. The cash to close was {cash_to_close}.
Hello, we are sending the documents for the loan application for {address}. Please tell us what is still missing.
Hello, please book the inspection of {address} for {date}. Please send the report within two days.
Hello, please send the report summary for {address}. We need the {issues_found} issues with a cost for each.
Inspector: the repair estimate is needed
Hello, please add a repair estimate to the report for {address}. Our own estimate is {repair_estimate}.
Contractor: walk the property, price it
Hello, please walk {address} and price the {category} work. Our estimate is {estimate}.
General contractor: the bid is due
Hello, your bid for {address} is due. Please send the price for {category}. Our estimate with contingency is {total_with_cont}.
Hello, our offer on {address} was accepted at {final_price}. Please open the closing file.
Hello, the closing date for {address} moved. Please confirm the new date with the seller side. The price stays {final_price}.
Hello, the cash needed to close {address} is {cash_to_close}. Please confirm the amount and the day to send it.
Insurance: a quote for the property
Hello, we are buying {address} for {final_price}. Please send a landlord insurance quote for the property.
Accountant: the deal closes this month
Hello, the purchase of {address} for {final_price} closes this month. Please note it for the year and the depreciation plan.
Assistant: chase the due diligence items
Hello, please chase the item {item} for {address}, due on {due_date}. Tell me when it is done.
Hello, we made an offer on {address}: {offer_price}. Please update the pipeline and set a follow-up.
Hello, please do this follow-up: {task} for {address}, due on {due_date}.
Owner: a deal meets the target return
Hello, the analysis {analysis_id} for {address} meets the return target. The cash flow is {cash_flow} a year and the DSCR is {dscr}.
Hello, our offer {offer_id} on {address} expires on {valid_until}. Please decide whether to extend it.
Hello, the analysis {analysis_id} for {address} is below the cash-on-cash target. The cash flow is {cash_flow} on {cash_in} put in.

Hello, for {address} the highest offer under the 70% rule is {max_offer}. The asking price is {asking_price}.
Owner: the weekly report is ready
Hello, the weekly pipeline report is ready. At the stage {stage} for {strategy} there are {deals_now} deals worth {asking_value}.

Open Start and type your company name and your numbers in the yellow cells: cash floor, usual owner draw, months of reserve, highest loan-to-value, down payment and closing shares and the cash-on-cash return you want.

Each month add a row on Cash: opening cash, rent in, sale proceeds, operating costs, loan payments, rehab spend, purchases, owner draw and closing cash. Cash in, cash out, net change and the 12-month totals fill in.
Every week add the bank balance on Weekly cash log. The gap to your cash floor and a check fill in.

Fill the 13-week forecast: expected rent, costs, loan payments, rehab draws, owner draw, other cash in, and the big payments in Purchases, balloon and set-aside. Amber is near the floor and red is below it.
Keep Upcoming payments up to date. Only open payments can be late; a payment due soon turns amber and an overdue one turns red.
On Reserves by property type the reserve you hold for each property. The loan payment, the monthly need, the reserve to hold, the months covered and the shortfall fill in.
Before you draw, read Owner draws: the safe draw now takes your cash flow and the lowest week of the forecast into account.
List every purchase you plan on Planned purchases and list your Funding sources. Cash needed, cash-on-cash and whether funding is in place fill in; the dashboard shows the gap you still have to fill.
Log every call for money on Capital calls. Set quarterly targets on Growth targets and compare scenarios on Growth scenarios.
